display_title: How I Got Knocked Up by My Beast Boss
mangabaka_title: How I Got Knocked Up by My Beast Boss
description:
He swallowed once and looked up at the hotel. Today, he hadn’t come to pick up a steak for his boss’s breakfast.

Today was the day he was meeting his boss’s family for marriage.

“Hey. Are you really going to marry me? You don’t even love me.”

Instead of answering, Yeonsim’s thoughts hurried back to two months ago.

***

Executive Director Seong Hyunho, infamous for his scandalous private life, had been caught leaving a hotel with his secretary on the very day of his formal meeting between families. His fiancée immediately called off the engagement, and Hyunho was in the middle of fleeing to avoid the chairman’s wrath.

Na Yeonsim, an employee who had been at the company for only a week, ended up hiding Seong Hyunho—the heir to Taekyung Group—under his desk, even while the chairman thundered in anger.

That was his mistake.

“Work with me.”   
"What... do you mean by that?"   
"I'm scouting you."

He wanted to say no. But Hyunho had taken a liking to Yeonsim’s quick thinking in hiding him and was completely stubborn about it. In the end, Yeonsim began his tearful life as a secretary.

"Just manage my private life."

Forced into becoming Hyunho’s secretary, Yeonsim was given the heavy responsibility of managing his boss’s scandalous private life.

And yet, the one who ended up rolling around in bed with him was Yeonsim himself—drunk out of his mind.

"Inside this peanut shape, this thing—it's beating."   
"What...... what's beating?"   
“The fetus heart.”

Just what exactly is this executive director, who doesn’t even seem surprised after getting a man pregnant?

And can I really give birth safely to this childish man’s baby?
